sections.name: General Knowledge, Current Affairs & UP Special GK

subjects.name: Child Development, Pedagogy, Teaching Skills & Life Skills (बाल विकास, शिक्षण कौशल एवं जीवन कौशल)
domains: Child Development: Heredity and Environment, Growth vs Development, Stages of Development (Infancy, Childhood, Adolescence)
Theories of Learning: Thorndike Trial & Error, Pavlov Classical Conditioning, Skinner Operant Conditioning, Kohler Insight Theory, Piaget Cognitive Development, Vygotsky Sociocultural Theory
Teaching Skills (शिक्षण कौशल): Teaching methods and maxims, Principles of teaching, Micro-teaching (सूक्ष्म शिक्षण), TLM, CCE, Inclusive Education
Life Skills & Management (जीवन कौशल एवं प्रबंधन): Professional conduct and ethics, Motivation (Intrinsic vs Extrinsic), Constitutional values, Role of rewards and penalties

subjects.name: Mathematics & Logical Knowledge / Reasoning (गणित एवं तार्किक ज्ञान)
domains: Number Systems & Fundamentals: Divisibility rules, Place value and Face value, Fractions, Decimals, LCM & HCF
Arithmetic Operations: Percentage, Profit, Loss and Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Ratio & Proportion, Average
Work, Speed & Mensuration: Time and Work, Speed, Time and Distance, 2D Area & Perimeter (Triangle, Rectangle, Circle), 3D Volume (Cube, Cuboid, Cylinder, Cone)
Logical Reasoning: Analogies, Coding-Decoding, Series, Blood Relations, Direction Sense, Venn Diagrams, Mathematical Operators

subjects.name: Languages - Hindi, English & Sanskrit Grammar (भाषा ज्ञान - हिन्दी, अंग्रेजी एवं संस्कृत व्याकरण)
domains: Hindi Vyakaran: वर्ण विचार (उच्चारण स्थान, अल्पप्राण/महाप्राण), संधि, समास, तत्सम-तद्भव, कारक, काल, वाच्य, संज्ञा, सर्वनाम, विशेषण, क्रिया, पर्यायवाची, विलोम, मुहावरे, वर्तनी शुद्धि
English Grammar: Parts of Speech, Articles, Prepositions, Tenses, Active/Passive Voice, Direct/Indirect Speech, Synonyms, Antonyms, Idioms
Sanskrit Vyakaran: माहेश्वर सूत्र, प्रत्याहार, वर्ण विचार, संधि (स्वर, व्यंजन, विसर्ग), समास, शब्द रूप (बालक, हरि, लता, नदी), धातु रूप (पठ्, गम्, भू), कारक एवं विभक्ति

subjects.name: Environmental Studies, Science, UP Special GK & Current Affairs (पर्यावरण अध्ययन, सामान्य विज्ञान एवं उत्तर प्रदेश विशेष सामान्य ज्ञान)
domains: Environmental Studies: Ecosystem, Food chains, Pollution, Biodiversity, Conservation, Wildlife Sanctuaries & National Parks
General Science: Motion, Light, Sound, Electricity, Acids-Bases-Salts, Metals, Cell structure, Human body systems, Nutrition & Diseases
Indian Constitution & Geography: Preamble, Fundamental Rights, DPSPs, President, Parliament, Rivers, Soils, Monsoons of India

Uttar Pradesh Special GK: UP Geography (Rivers, Soils, Climate), History, 1857 Revolt in UP (Meerut, Jhansi, Kanpur, Lucknow), Protected areas (Dudhwa National Park, Chandraprabha, Okhla Bird Sanctuary), UP Culture, Folk Dances (Kathak, Charkula, Raslila), Handicrafts & GI Tags (Chikan of Lucknow, Brassware of Moradabad, Glass of Firozabad, Carpets of Bhadohi), UP Census 2011

master_bundled_notes.title: UP TET & Super TET Master Bundle 3: Mathematics, Numerical Aptitude & Reasoning Simulation
master_bundled_notes.focus: Number system, BODMAS, commercial math (percentage, profit-loss, CI-SI), 2D/3D mensuration, coding-decoding, series, blood relations

master_bundled_notes.title: UP TET & Super TET Master Bundle 4: Trilingual Mastery - Hindi, English & Sanskrit Grammar
master_bundled_notes.focus: Hindi संधि, समास, कारक, तत्सम-तद्भव, English prepositions, voice, tenses, Sanskrit माहेश्वर सूत्र, प्रत्याहार एवं शब्द/धातु रूप

master_bundled_notes.title: UP TET & Super TET Master Bundle 5: Environmental Studies, Science, Polity & UP Special GK
